name: K3s Lightweight Kubernetes (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 lightweight, production-ready Kubernetes distribution with bundled control plane, container runtime and cluster utilities; no software license fee or vendor-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: Operate your own Linux nodes, network, persistent volumes, backups, security updates and monitoring; cloud VMs, storage and load balancers may be billed. K3s is a Kubernetes distribution, not a free managed cluster.
